q: Which grid emission factor does a CCTS obligated plant use for purchased electricity?
title: CCTS grid factor for obligated plants
short: The latest CEA average grid factor applied in the baseline year, kept fixed for every compliance year, so a plant gets no benefit from the grid getting cleaner. With a dedicated power purchase deal it uses the supplier's verified factor, or 1.19 t CO2 per MWh as default.

sections.h: Purchased electricity in BEE's compliance procedure
ul: Use the latest average grid emission factor from CEA's CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian power sector.
The factor applied in the baseline year applies across the compliance years. There is no normalisation for power mix, so credit comes only from the plant's own actions.

With a dedicated power purchase agreement, use the supplier-specific factor with documents verified by an accredited agency. If none is available, use the default of 1.19 t CO2 per MWh published by CEA.
Purchased or exported heat uses the emission factor of the steam generation fuel mix, in g CO2 per kcal.

p: Cutting grid electricity, or moving to verified renewable supply, still lowers reported intensity. A newer, lower CEA factor does not.

senseible: Senseible keeps a plant's fuel and electricity invoices as dated, fingerprinted monthly records, the activity data its monitoring plan and verifier work from.
